predictor.notes: Retained the saved predictor: no new price evidence supports a change. Additional probes at quantities 100 and 300 were denied on all four workflows. The only observed exact prices remain 159900 cents at quantity 50 and 373000 cents at quantity 200; this predictor matches both. Arithmetic checks confirmed that positive, strictly increasing quadratic alternatives also match both observations while differing substantially elsewhere, so linearity is not established. This is a minimal-complexity interpolation/extrapolation, not an exact full-domain reconstruction. The other 998 quantities remain unobserved; transitions and finite error bounds cannot be inferred. Cumulative usage: 30 business requests and 4 REA operations, including inspection.
